examples.arabic: نحن قرانا ثلاثة كتب عن الطبخ اليوم
examples.english: We read three books about cooking today.
examples.transliteration: Nahnu qarana thalathat kutub an al-tabkh al-yawm

examples.arabic: هم كتبوا رسائل جميلة وقدموا له ثلاثة كتب جديدة كهدية
examples.english: They wrote beautiful letters and presented him with three new books as a gift.
examples.transliteration: Hum katabu rasa'il jameelah wa qaddamu lahu thalathat kutub jadeedah ka-hadiya
